AnimaMultiSave.description: Multi-port save: 12 IMAGE inputs (the dynamic-port variant can grow freely). Saves whichever port ran furthest (highest priority), with overwrite mode, stale-file cleanup and metadata stripping.

filename_prefix.name: Filename prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Output filename prefix. Subfolders are allowed (anima/result -> output/anima/); ComfyUI variables such as %date% / %width% work too.

output_mode.name: Output mode
output_mode.tooltip: best_only: save only the highest-priority port (recommended). all_inputs: save every port that carries an image, each with a _p1/_p2... suffix.

priority_order.name: Priority order
priority_order.tooltip: high_port_first: higher port numbers win (wire the final image to the highest port). low_port_first: lower port numbers win.

format.name: Format
format.tooltip: png is lossless; jpg / webp are lossy but much smaller.

quality.name: Quality
quality.tooltip: Quality for jpg / webp. Ignored for png.

png_compress_level.name: PNG compress level
png_compress_level.tooltip: PNG compression level. Affects file size and save speed only, not image quality.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.tooltip: strip_all: write nothing and strip prompt / workflow / EXIF metadata chunk by chunk. embed_workflow: embed the workflow like the native SaveImage node (png only).

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.tooltip: False (recommended): create a new file each run so history and queue thumbnails stay distinct. True: always overwrite the same filenames; the node then writes a uniquely named preview copy under temp/ so history does not collapse onto the latest image.

clean_stale.name: Clean stale files
clean_stale.tooltip: Only used when overwrite=True: also remove stale frames from the same prefix that this run did not produce (strict prefix[_pN]_00001 matches only).

images_1.name: Image 1
images_1.tooltip: Image for port 1. Empty when not connected / muted / bypassed; the node then steps down to the next port.
